name: fix-keyboard-layout-slovak
title: Fix Keyboard Layout (Slovak)
description: Fix text typed with the wrong keyboard layout – converts between English (US/ABC) and Slovak keyboards, e.g. "m83 nov0 m]so" → "máš nové mäso".
author: matus-markusek

commands.name: fix-layout
commands.title: Fix Keyboard Layout
commands.subtitle: Auto-detect
commands.description: Detect which layout the selected text was typed in and convert it to the other one.

commands.name: en-to-sk
commands.title: Convert English Layout to Slovak
commands.subtitle: EN → SK
commands.description: Text typed on the English keyboard that should have been Slovak ("m83" → "máš").

commands.name: sk-to-en
commands.title: Convert Slovak Layout to English
commands.subtitle: SK → EN
commands.description: Text typed on the Slovak keyboard that should have been English ("it§s" → "it's").

commands.name: preview-conversion
commands.title: Preview Keyboard Layout Conversion
commands.subtitle: EN ⇄ SK
commands.description: Type or paste text and see it converted in both directions, then paste or copy the result.

preferences.name: slovakLayout
preferences.title: Slovak Layout
preferences.description: Which Slovak keyboard layout you use in macOS.

preferences.name: keepNumbers
preferences.title: Numbers
preferences.label: Keep standalone numbers unchanged
preferences.description: Words made only of digits (e.g. 2025, 10.5) are not converted.

preferences.name: useClipboard
preferences.title: Clipboard
preferences.label: Convert clipboard when nothing is selected
preferences.description: If no text is selected, convert the clipboard content and copy the result back to the clipboard.
